WITH us_movie_companies AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT mc.movie_id
    FROM company_name AS cn
    JOIN movie_companies AS mc ON cn.id = mc.company_id
    WHERE cn.country_code = '[us]'
      AND mc.note LIKE '%(200%)%'
      AND (mc.note LIKE '%(USA)%' OR mc.note LIKE '%(worldwide)%')
),
release_date_info AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT mi.movie_id
    FROM movie_info AS mi
    JOIN info_type AS it ON it.id = mi.info_type_id
    WHERE it.info = 'release dates'
      AND mi.info IS NOT NULL
      AND (mi.info LIKE 'Japan:%2007%' OR mi.info LIKE 'USA:%2008%')
),
kung_fu_titles AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT t.id, t.title
    FROM title AS t
    JOIN us_movie_companies AS umc ON umc.movie_id = t.id
    JOIN release_date_info AS rdi ON rdi.movie_id = t.id
    WHERE t.production_year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2008
      AND t.title LIKE '%Kung%Fu%Panda%'
),
per_title_cast AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT MIN(n.name) AS voicing_actress,
           kt.title AS kung_fu_panda
    FROM kung_fu_titles AS kt
    JOIN cast_info AS ci ON ci.movie_id = kt.id
    JOIN role_type AS rt ON rt.id = ci.role_id
    JOIN name AS n ON n.id = ci.person_id
    JOIN aka_name AS an ON an.person_id = n.id AND an.person_id = ci.person_id
    JOIN char_name AS chn ON chn.id = ci.person_role_id
    WHERE ci.note = '(voice)'
      AND rt.role = 'actress'
      AND n.gender = 'f'
      AND n.name LIKE '%Angel%'
    GROUP BY kt.id, kt.title
)
SELECT MIN(voicing_actress) AS voicing_actress,
       MIN(kung_fu_panda) AS kung_fu_panda
FROM per_title_cast
